name: ACL Live at The Moody Theater

bagPolicy.summary: No backpacks or large bags over 11”x17” are allowed. Diaper and medical bags are permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Diaper and medical bags are permitted.

parking.note: There is no official parking garage affiliated with ACL Live, but nearby options are available. Limited valet parking is offered at the W Hotel for ticketholders on a first-come, first-served basis. Metered parking starts at $2 per hour with varying hours.

rideshare.note: Let Lyft be your ride to the action! Use code ACLLIVELYFT for 50% off your first 2 rides (up to $10/ride).

concessions.note: The FAQ page does not provide specific details about food and drink options or any special offerings at ACL Live at The Moody Theater.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating and guest accommodations are available. Contact ACL Live at 512-404-1300 or info@acllive.com before the event for seating, mobility, hearing, or other access needs.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is generally allowed when guests present their ticket again and repeat security screening. Events that prohibit re-entry are identified at the entrance.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The event-day box office is on 2nd Street between Lavaca and Guadalupe, next to the ACL Live retail store. It opens one hour before the scheduled door time; photo ID is required for will-call pickup.

gates.title: Entrance & Doors
gates.body: Enter from the 2nd Street side of the venue and allow at least 30 extra minutes for wanding and bag checks. Door times are listed for each event.
